WITH relevant_amounts AS (
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment"
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve"
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment"
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve"
),
claim_policy_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier, p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
    ON pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
),
claims_agg AS (
  SELECT cpm.Policy_Identifier, cpm.Policy_Number,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cpm.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM claim_policy_map cpm
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cpm.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN relevant_amounts ra
    ON ra.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY cpm.Policy_Identifier, cpm.Policy_Number
),
premium_agg AS (
  SELECT p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number
)
SELECT
  pr.Policy_Number,
  pr.Policy_Identifier,
  pr.premium,
  COALESCE(ca.number_of_claims, 0) AS number_of_claims,
  COALESCE(ca.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
  CASE WHEN pr.premium = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ca.total_loss, 0) / pr.premium END AS loss_ratio
FROM premium_agg pr
LEFT JOIN claims_agg ca
  ON ca.Policy_Identifier = pr.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY pr.Policy_Number
LIMIT 500
